title: lcn-cog at 1.5x resolution (R=15, 288^2): cogs still form from noise with the shell band scaled 1.5x and still die when their food is cut, but fewer persist (spontaneous deaths with food present)
summary: Resolution continuation of 20261025T1559-c18-rtwo56-food-cogs-claim with kernel radius 10 -> 15 and diffusivities scaled. The A1 shell band moves from r=7-8 to r=12 and the trough from r=3 to r=4-5 (shell/trough >= 7 in every isolated cell-frame, 2 seeds). A local food cut kills the cut cog by t=635 while its fed twin and all other cogs stay at 1.00 (seed 2). Fewer cogs persist (3 and 6 at t=1000 vs 14 and 11 at R=10): several die with food plentiful.

finding.operator: r-two56 set-point shell on a closed food-waste cycle
finding.control: 1.5x resolution continuation (R=15, grid 288, diffusivities scaled), 2 seeds pack + 1 seed fork
finding.result: shell band r 7-8 -> 12, trough 3 -> 4-5; per-cell shell/trough >= 7.2; cut cog dead by t=635, fed twin 1.00; persisting cogs 3/6 vs 14/11 at R=10
